description: Department of Census and Statistics - The National Consumer Price Index July - 2024.
categorisation: This gazette notification announces the National Consumer Price Index figure for July 2024, which is a statistical publication by the Department of Census and Statistics. This content does not involve government structure/personnel (Types 1-3) and does not fit any of the specialized categories (Types 4-9) such as land, legal, commercial, elections, public service, or judicial matters. It represents statistical/economic data reporting, which falls under miscellaneous administrative matters.
